::: {#exm-pipes-tree}
#### The pipes form a tree

The houses and pipes of @exr-pipes form a graph (@def-graph-vertices-edges) $P$,
with vertex set $\set{p, q, r, s, t, u, w}$ and the six edges listed there.
$P$ is a tree (@def-tree).

- It is connected (@def-connected).
  The walks $q, p$ and $q, r$ and $q, s$ and $q, s, t$ and $q, s, t, u$ and $q, s, t, w$ go from $q$ to every other vertex,
  and reading one of them backward and then following another gives a walk between any two vertices.
- It has no cycles, by @lem-degree-one.
  Take out $p$, $r$, $u$ and $w$, which have degree 1.
  Then $q$ and $t$ have degree 1; take out $q$.
  Then $t$ has degree 1; take it out.
  What is left is the vertex $s$ with no edges.

:::
